sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; UniClawBench ranked first after recent-topic exclusions and exact latest-data dedupe.
Main agent read arXiv metadata, HTML, PDF-extracted text, GitHub README, runtime docs, task schema docs, supervisor/user-simulator docs, and reproducibility notes.

Article decomposes five capability buckets, task package schema, three-role closed-loop evaluation, information firewall, PR/AS metrics, cross-model and cross-framework results, token-cycle progression, and engineering reproducibility.

Analysis separates final pass rate from checkpoint score, flags single-run/no-error-bar limits, live-environment drift, LLM supervisor bias, hand-built task coverage, and framework implementation confounds.
Related positioning covers WebArena, OSWorld, VisualWebArena, ClawBench, LiveClawBench, ClawMark, SkillsBench, and SkillCenter.
Markdown uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formula blocks, Mermaid, and no external image URLs; key figures are reconstructed textually.
